rules.what_counts: a (law, n_t) row is ESTABLISHED only by formally scored PASS rows of a declared, SHA-pinned contact protocol run on a clean tree; sliding_mu_max = the largest scored mu whose slip rows (RUBBER-CONT-01 b, -04 a) and every lower scored mu pass; static_mu_max = the largest scored mu whose holds at tan(theta) = 0.95 mu (RUBBER-CONT-01 a) pass
rules.diagnostic_rows: DIAGNOSTIC evidence may only NARROW an established row, never widen it or establish a row
rules.not_established: a row with status NOT_ESTABLISHED has no envelope: every friction value is refused for it
rules.unlisted: a (law, n_t) pair without a row is refused (in particular grid_node_penalty_coulomb_v1, superseded, and every n_t outside the listed set)
rules.absolute_limit: mu >= 1.0 is refused for every row (label contact_coulomb_ill_posed, ADR 0023 §22.9-§22.11)
rules.p2_6_range: friction_table ~ U[0.3, min over the slot set's n_t of sliding_mu_max(law, n_t)] (0.3 = the recipe's lower bound); BLOCKED if any slot's row is not established; friction_pad and friction_self fixed at the recipe values and declared unused (no pads, no self-contact physics)
